caption: Each keystroke restarts the 300 ms timer: the windows last 120, 130 and 150 ms, all short of 300, so only q=dosa reaches 300 ms of silence and one GET leaves at 700 ms. With no operators, four GETs would leave at 0, 120, 250 and 400 ms.

spec.aria: A timeline in milliseconds with four lanes: q=d holds a timer from 0 to 120 ms, q=do from 120 to 250 ms, q=dos from 250 to 400 ms, and q=dosa from 400 to 700 ms, where a single GET request is sent.
